name: National Cyber Crime Helpline
situation: I lost money to an online scam
description: Call 1930 immediately. Then file or complete the complaint on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.

name: Sanchar Saathi Chakshu
situation: I received a suspicious call, SMS, or WhatsApp message
description: Report suspected fraud communications such as fake KYC, impersonation, or threatening disconnection messages.

name: RBI Sachet
situation: I found a suspicious deposit or investment scheme
description: Check information about deposit-taking entities and report unauthorized deposit collection.

name: CEIR lost or stolen phone service
situation: My phone was lost or stolen
description: Use the Government of India service to request blocking of a lost or stolen mobile handset.
